listeningQuestions.audio: Zhong Yang gave his life to collecting seeds in Tibet.
opts: 钟扬一生致力于在西藏采集种子。

listeningQuestions.audio: Franklin's photograph held the key to the shape of DNA.
opts: 富兰克林的照片藏着DNA形状的关键。

listeningQuestions.audio: Hawking kept working for more than fifty years.
opts: 霍金坚持工作了五十多年。

listeningQuestions.audio: Curie won the Nobel Prize in two different fields.
opts: 居里夫人在两个不同领域获得诺贝尔奖。

listeningQuestions.audio: Every great discovery begins with a simple question.
opts: 每个伟大的发现都始于一个简单的问题。

listeningQuestions.audio: The young students were amazed by the model of the human body.
opts: 学生们对模型毫无兴趣。
年轻学生被人体模型深深震撼。

quizQuestions.q: We ____ this rich seed bank to Zhong Yang.（归功于）
She had an undying ____ for science all her life.（酷爱）
Franklin received almost no ____ for her key discovery.（认可）
Despite all the ____, the team never gave up.（艰难）
The results of the experiment were truly ____.
When the monkeys survived, the scientists were ____.
Her dream job is ____ new planets in deep space.
For many years, the mystery of DNA remained ____.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他从不后悔成为一名科学家。
quizQuestions.audio: He has never regretted being a scientist.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 好奇心是科学家最重要的品质之一。
quizQuestions.audio: Curiosity is one of the most important qualities of a scientist.

reading.passage: John Goodenough did some of his best work after the age of seventy. He helped invent a battery that now powers phones and cars all over the world. In 2019, at the age of ninety-seven, he became the oldest person ever to win a Nobel Prize, showing that it is never too late to make a great contribution.
reading.passageCn: 约翰·古迪纳夫在七十岁之后完成了他最出色的一些工作。他帮助发明了如今为全世界手机和汽车供电的电池。2019年，九十七岁的他成为获诺贝尔奖年龄最大的人，证明了做出伟大贡献永远不嫌晚。

questions.q: What did Goodenough help to invent?
opts: A battery used in phones and cars.

questions.q: Why is his 2019 prize so remarkable?
opts: He was the oldest person ever to win a Nobel Prize.
He was the youngest winner ever.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph about a scientist you admire. Say who the person is, what they did, and why you admire them. Try to use the unit's -ing/-ed forms as predicatives.
writing.promptCn: 写一小段你敬佩的科学家:他/她是谁、做了什么、你为什么敬佩(试着用本单元的 -ing/-ed 形式作表语，如 inspiring / inspired)。

lines.text: Which scientist do you admire most?
Marie Curie. Her story is really inspiring.
lines.cn: 居里夫人。她的故事真的很鼓舞人心。

lines.text: Why are you so inspired by her?
lines.cn: 你为什么这么受她鼓舞?

lines.text: Because she never gave up, even when it was hard.
lines.cn: 因为即使再难，她也从不放弃。

lines.text: Did you hear about the ninety-seven-year-old Nobel winner?
lines.cn: 你听说那位九十七岁的诺贝尔奖得主了吗?

lines.text: Yes! It's amazing that he was still working at that age.
lines.cn: 听说了!他那个年纪还在工作，太了不起了。

lines.text: It shows it's never too late to make a contribution.
lines.cn: 这说明做出贡献永远不嫌晚。

lines.text: Exactly. I feel really encouraged by his story.
lines.cn: 正是。我被他的故事深深鼓舞。
